description: React component for filtering posts based on search query, tags, locations, sort order, and status. Manages filter state and provides UI for user interaction.

methods.name: PostFilters
methods.description: React functional component for filtering posts, using hooks for internal state management.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the filter state, trimming whitespace and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a specified tag from the filter state.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Adds a new location to the filter state, trimming whitespace and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: removeLocation
methods.description: Removes a specified location from the filter state.
